capabilities: fuzzy-search text on canvas cards, linked notes, link URLs and group names
jump to and centre the canvas on a matched card
search the open canvas or every .canvas file in the vault
match with tolerance for typos and initials in short titles
disambiguation: It searches inside canvases; it does not create or edit cards.
extras: Read-only: it only reads canvases and never changes them, and has no settings. Search of file cards covers only the first 20,000 characters of the linked note.
problem: Obsidian's Canvas has no built-in way to find a specific card or search text inside cards on a large canvas.
summary: Fuzzy search for card text, linked note content, link URLs and group names on a canvas, jumping to and centring on the match.
